pool.text: Construction of the city of Jaipur began under its ruler.
Sawai Jai Singh II founded the planned city of Jaipur.
A school of art was founded fostering metalwork and marble industries.
Jaipur Junction railway station was built at the centre of Rajasthan.
The city was painted pink to welcome Albert Edward, Prince of Wales.
The rapidly growing city reached a population of 160,000 residents.
Jaipur became the capital of the newly formed state of Rajasthan.
Heavy rains from a cloudburst caused massive flooding and eight deaths.
Jaipur Stock Exchange was founded as a regional stock exchange in India.
The Jaipur Municipal Corporation was established to manage city governance.
Pink City Express got replaced by now running Ajmer Shatabdi Express.
The Mountain Goats released an album featuring a song about the city.
The local airport was officially granted the status of international airport.
Jaipur BRTS transportation project was approved by the government.
Jaipur was ranked among the top Emerging Global Outsourcing cities.
A section of the North-South Corridor transportation route became operational.
World Trade Park Jaipur shopping mall was opened to the public.
Jaipur Metro commenced commercial operation on its first major route.
JMC was bifurcated into two separate municipal entities with numerous wards.
The two municipal bodies were re-merged into a single municipal corporation.
